column3: description
an in-memory row remains live without occupying disk scratch, a spilled row appends exactly once, and a stored spill error leaves scratch unchanged
the reader preserves row order, latched errors, stable end and close semantics, and remains valid while a shallow handle spills
a reader scans exactly the chunk extent captured at construction and never consumes a later append
list construction, row pointers, append/add routing, allocation and reuse preserve row order and chunk boundaries
GetChunk exposes the live stored chunk and Rust makes mutation authority explicit through an exclusive list borrow
memory accounting deliberately lags the writable tail, reset charges and recycles it, allocation releases its charge, and clear returns to zero
Walk visits rows in chunk order, handles an empty list, and stops at the first callback error
field-type dispatch, unsigned routing, NULL-first ordering, collation, numeric, temporal, JSON, BIT, name-value, vector and unsupported-type behavior match the accepted comparator authority
cell-to-datum dispatch preserves range sentinels, float32 normalization, datum collation, raw byte families, exact numeric and temporal ordering, vector ordering, and KindRaw default equality
LowerBound returns the first not-less row and reports equality across duplicates, NULL prefixes, sentinels, out-of-range probes and collated strings
UpperBound returns the first strictly greater row across duplicates, NULL prefixes, sentinels, out-of-range probes and collated strings
allocator configuration clamps accepted bounds without eagerly reserving the cache ceiling and each new allocator snapshots the configured limits
allocator leases preserve chunk shape, bounded allocation-time ownership, reset reuse, column width admission, alias deduplication, borrowed-column rejection and stale-generation safety
empty, hook-once and synchronized allocator adapters preserve allocation shape, reuse admission, delegation and concurrent safety
Pool initializes synchronized physical-width buckets, constructs empty and populated chunks, resets returned columns, preserves reachable var/4/8/40 widths and publishes each aliased owner once
global capacity buckets create on first get or put, reuse on later access, remain synchronized and never cross initial capacities
Chunk preserves construction, state, selection, append, transform, identity and lifecycle semantics
packed fixed and variable cells append the intended payload and return the advanced native offset
Chunk text preserves logical row order, accepted separators, newlines and arbitrary source bytes
Row preserves sentinel and chunk identity, logical-to-physical indexing, typed access and datum conversion across field families
Row copy construction returns one independently owned row selected from the source
Row text preserves NULL, every reachable eval family, accepted separators and arbitrary source bytes
